# Patching a budget without recreating it

## When to use

- Raising or lowering the ceiling on an existing budget without losing its history.
- Switching a budget's rollover period after a policy change.
- Toggling `enforced` and `paused` flags alongside other field changes in a single atomic call.

## Notes

- Only `name`, `ceiling_usd`, `period`, `enforced`, and `paused` are accepted. Any other keys in the patch are silently dropped.
- Changing `period` archives the current window as a spend log entry, resets `spent_usd` to zero, and clears `last_fired_period_start` on every alert before the new period anchors.
- The update runs inside a per-budget lock; concurrent `budget::record` calls queue behind it.
- For a single-flag toggle, `budget::enforce` and `budget::pause` are the more explicit shorthands.
